{{Infobox auto}}

'''Sun-dried tomatoes''' are the preservation of [[tomatoes]]. They heal {{Value|Sun-dried Tomatoes|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Strength}} for {{Value|Sun-dried Tomatoes|duration|effect=Strength}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_tomatoes.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Raw tomatoes, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. Picking up tomatoes unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating sun-dried tomatoes takes {{Value|Sun-dried Tomatoes|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Sun-dried Tomatoes|heals}} and gives Strength {{Value|Sun-dried Tomatoes|level|effect=Strength}} for {{Value|Sun-dried Tomatoes|duration|effect=Strength|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
